print('bytes', len(pol))
t=time.time(); rules,a,p = parse_policy(pol); print('parse', round(time.time()-t,3), a, p)
t=time.time()
try:
    acc, rows, cells = compile_policy(rules, names, idx); print('compile', round(time.time()-t,3), 'rows', len(rows), 'cells', cells)
except Exception as e: print('compile', round(time.time()-t,3), 'EXC', e)
PYEOF
